description:
Fetch an owner-published CVder resume by its share link or slug.

        Accepts a full share URL (https://cvder.app/cv/rsm_...) or a bare
        rsm_ slug. Only resumes the owner has explicitly shared are
        reachable; email, phone and location are redacted by the server.

        format: "raw" (default) returns CVder's native resume shape;
        "json_resume" returns JSON Resume v1.0.0 (jsonresume.org) with
        CVder-only fields preserved under x_cvder — prefer it for
        interchange with other tools or when a standard schema matters.
name: get_shared_resume
title: Get Shared Resume
